findings.summary: ROOT CAUSE of the empty team delivery (sole witness = this raw log): after ~20.5 min of legitimate context loading (control plane, accepted evidence, scaling artifacts), the TEAM GRAPH session attempted to stage Playwright browsers for a books.toscrape live probe ('mkdir -p /tmp/opencode/ms-playwright && cp -r /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/* /tmp/opencode/ms-playwright/' + Session().goto probe). OpenCode emitted 'permission requested: external_directory (/tmp/opencode/*, /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/*); auto-rejecting' → 'The user rejected permission to use this specific tool call' → whole session ended at 18:10:40Z with ZERO commits. Persist step then force-pushed the unchanged base tree ('nothing to commit, working tree clean') under conclusion=success. This is a NEW variant (~instance #7) of the permission-kill family: tool-artifact/cache staging paths outside the workspace, distinct from prior wrong-path/hallucinated-path/parent-of-repo variants.

Round-0 EMPTY production snapshot caught by independent audit: 'TEAM GRAPH produced zero new commits in both attempts... the predeclared pipeline was never started. Empty production failure, not a scientific result of any direction: NOT site-bound, NOT instrument-unrepairable, NOT a null.' Gate REVISE/safe_to_integrate=false with five concrete required fixes (RF-1 P0 prereg-before-outcome incl. spent-instrument roles; RF-2 P1 producer repair under legitimacy boundary with non-vacuous contamination gates citing run 32793580374 F1 lesson; RF-3 exact frozen P2 grid with discipline fields + perf_counter timing; RF-4 report with equal-prominence negatives + ladder-compliant wording; RF-5 phase-by-phase run manifest + both empty attempt branches preserved + non-empty scope-clean diff vs 3e36b4c). Predeclared escalation rule: another empty/no-diff return without an inspectable blocker record ⇒ BLOCKED (repetitive busywork, constitution §7). director_note bindingly forbids narrating this cycle as null/pause/SITE-BOUND/BOOKS-INSTRUMENT-UNREPAIRABLE.

Auditor's structural reliability observation (recorded as provenance): this is the SECOND round-0 empty delivery at a program start in the last five audited Graph rounds, both occurring when a whole multi-phase program was assigned to one team phase. Suggests a workflow-design coupling between single-phase program scope and empty-snapshot risk, not agent randomness. Workflows are outside auditor write authority — flagged for orchestration owners only.

Run wall cost ≈33.5 min producing zero bytes of cycle work (team ~21.0m mostly context loading before the fatal probe; audit ~12.3m well spent — it recomputed contamination-gate history and wrote the full gate). Downstream compounding: two additional repair rounds were needed before integration (r1 = run 32883457025 REVISE RF-D1..RF-D5; r2 = run 32900187567 PASS) — i.e., this permission kill converted one cycle into three before any BOOKS-inventory outcome existed.

failure_signatures: external_directory auto-reject killing an entire OpenCode session mid-cycle when staging tool/browser caches between runner-HOME cache (/home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright) and /tmp/opencode; session ends with zero commits while the workflow still reports job success and pushes an unchanged tree
empty-team-snapshot-at-program-start: team+attempt branches byte-identical to accepted base; detectable cheaply by comparing persisted tree hash to base before auditing
research_opportunities: Fix class for the permission-kill family: pre-stage browser/tool caches INSIDE the workspace (or allowlist /tmp/opencode + runner cache dirs for lane sessions) so producer probes never trigger external_directory auto-reject; a pre-audit empty-tree check would convert silent empty deliveries into fast explicit failures without burning the audit half-cycle.
